description: A narrow shopfront wedged between the studio blocks, its window whitewashed from the inside and a letting notice taped to the glass at a hopeful angle. The old fascia has been unbolted, leaving four bright screw-holes and a ghost of the name that used to be there. Whoever takes it gets the best-looked-at forty feet of pavement on Marrow Street.
name: Unit 4, Marrow Street
